questions.stem: Artificial Neural Network అంటే ఏమిటి? Human Brain Neurons నుంచి Inspiration తీసుకుని Mathematical Neurons ఎలా Connect అయి Learn చేస్తాయి?
questions.figure:
01 / biology vs math

A real neuron inspires the idea; a network computes with numbers

Artificial neurons take inspiration from connected brain cells, but they are simplified mathematical functions—not realistic simulations of biological signaling.
options: Human Brainలో Electric Signals, Chemical Messagesని Exactగా Copy చేస్తుంది. Artificial Neurons Biological Cellsలాగే Every Detailలో Work చేస్తాయని Incorrectly Claim చేస్తుంది.
Trainingలో Adjust అయ్యే Weightsతో Connected Mathematical Units Build చేస్తుంది. Brain Neurons Inspiration మాత్రమే; Real Brainకి Exact Digital Copy కాదు.
Human Brain Responses Tableలో Save చేసి Nearest Response Lookup చేస్తుంది. ఇది Learnable Neural Connections ఉన్న Networkతో Same Process కాదు.
Human-Written Fixed Logic Rules Connect చేసి Numerical Weights Learn చేయదు. Rule-Based Systems Useful అయినా Trainable Neural Network Structure Different.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Approaching Personని Recognize చేసే Automatic Doorలో Sensor Readings Neural Networkకి Inputs. Trainable Weights Learn అయ్యి “Open now” వంటి Prediction ఇవ్వగలవు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Automatic Door Sensors Person దగ్గరపడుతున్నట్లు Signal ఇస్తాయి. Neural Network Mathematical Units ద్వారా Readings Combine చేసి Open/Close Prediction ఇస్తుంది; Each Connection Weight Trainingలో Adjust అవుతుంది. Human Brain నుంచి Loose Inspiration మాత్రమే, Biological Cell Copy కాదు. Typical Artificial Neuron Weighted Sum + Bias + Activation Compute చేస్తుంది. ఇది Biological Cell Chemistryని Exactగా Simulate చేయదు; Brain Connections నుంచి Loose Inspiration మాత్రమే.

questions.figure:
02 / layered weighted graph

A neural network is a directed web of weighted connections

Each connection carries a learned weight. Each hidden neuron combines weighted inputs with a bias and activation; the output layer turns the resulting features into predictions.
options: Hidden Neurons Input Numbersని Without Changes Direct Copy చేస్తాయి. Connections Strength Learn కాకపోవడం వల్ల Output కూడా Same Features మాత్రమే Receive చేస్తుందని Assume చేస్తుంది.
Input Layer Correct Labelsని Invent చేస్తుంది; Biases Weighted Connectionsని Replace చేస్తాయి. Normally Training Labels Data నుంచి వస్తాయి; Weights, Biases Both Needed.
Hidden Layers All Previous Predictions Store చేసి Output Most Common Answer Choose చేస్తుంది. ఇది Standard Feedforward Computation కాకుండా Memory Lookupలా ఉంటుంది.

03 / forward pass signal calculation

Watch two inputs become one prediction, step by step

Worked example: z = 2 × 0.6 + 1 × 0.4 − 0.5 = 1.1. Sigmoid(1.1) ≈ 0.750. The activation reshapes the weighted sum; this is a demonstration, not a measured prediction.
options: Each Neuron Inputsని Weightsతో Multiply చేసి Bias Add చేస్తుంది; Activation Apply చేసి Result Forward Pass చేస్తుంది. Last Layer Final Output Predict చేస్తుంది.
Signals First Outputకి Jump అయి తర్వాత Hidden Layersలో Calculations Run చేస్తాయి. Forward Propagationలో Hidden Processing Outputకి ముందే జరగాలి.
Neurons Input Values Average చేస్తాయి; Activation Function Alone Weight Updates చేస్తుంది. Actually Activation Signal Transform చేస్తుంది, Optimizer Weights Update చేస్తుంది.
Model Current Input Receive చేయకముందే Prediction Error Measure చేసి Lossని New Inputగా Use చేస్తుంది. Loss Usually Forward Prediction తర్వాత Calculate అవుతుంది.

Later Neurons Combine చేసి Output Busy Level Predict చేస్తాయి. Trainingలో Prediction తర్వాత Loss Measure చేసి Parameters Update చేస్తాం. Neuron z = Σ(wᵢxᵢ)+b Compute చేసి Activation Apply చేస్తుంది. Example: 2×0.6 + 1×0.4 − 0.5 = 1.1; Sigmoid(1.1) సుమారు 0.750.

questions.figure:
04 / loss gradient update loop

Learning is a feedback loop: predict, measure error, correct

The example uses L(w)=½(w−0.3)². At w=0.80, the gradient is 0.50. One step with learning rate 0.10 moves w to 0.75 and lowers loss from 0.125 to 0.10125.
options: Wrong Prediction వచ్చినప్పుడల్లా Network More Neurons Add చేస్తుంది, Gradients Calculate చేయదు. Bigger Structure Alone Existing Weightsని Improve చేయలేదు.
Optimizer Correct Labelsని Model Guessesకి Match అయ్యేలా Change చేస్తుంది. Error Score Smaller కనిపించినా Intended Learning జరగదు.
Loss Prediction Errorని Measure చేస్తుంది; Backpropagation Each Parameter Gradient Find చేస్తుంది; Optimizer Weights Update చేసి Future Predictions Improve చేస్తుంది.
Hidden Neurons Wrong Answers Memorize చేసి Gradientsతో Training Examples Remove చేస్తాయి. This Avoids Weight Updates, కానీ Normal Gradient Descent అలా Work కాదు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Bread Ovenకి Model 20 Minutes Predict చేసి Actual 28 Minutes అయితే Loss Difference Measure చేస్తుంది. Backprop Gradients, Optimizer Small Weight Changes చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Bread Bake Time Forecastలో Prediction 20 min, Actual 28 min అనుకుందాం. Loss Differenceని Measure చేస్తుంది; Backpropagation Weights Errorపై Impact Find చేస్తుంది; Optimizer Weights Small Stepsలో Update చేస్తుంది. Three Roles: Loss → Gradients → Updates. Forward Pass Prediction, Loss Error Measure, Backprop Gradients Compute, Optimizer Updates Repeat చేస్తుంది. Gradient Weight Change Lossపై ఎలా Affect చేస్తుందో చూపిస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Python, PyTorchలో Feedforward Neural Networkని Dataset, Layers, Activation Functions, Loss, Optimizer, Evaluationతో ఎలా Build చేసి Train చేస్తాం?
questions.figure:
05 / pytorch xor lab

Build and train a small network on a real nonlinear classification task

xor_neural_network.py · tested PyTorch
import torch
from torch import nn

torch.manual_seed(7)
X = torch.tensor([[0.,0.],[0.,1.],
                  [1.,0.],[1.,1.]])
y = torch.tensor([[0.],[1.],[1.],[0.]])
model = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2,8),
                      nn.Tanh(), nn.Linear(8,1))
loss_fn = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
opt = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.05)
for epoch in range(401):
    model.train()
    loss = loss_fn(model(X), y)
    opt.zero_grad()
    loss.backward()
    opt.step()

model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    pred = (model(X).sigmoid() >= 0.5).int()
    print(pred.flatten().tolist())
# [0, 1, 1, 0] (tested, CPU)
Four-point XOR dataset
Predicted labels: [0, 1, 1, 0]

This evaluates the four training examples to demonstrate learning. For generalization, use a separate validation or test set.

This runnable example prepares tensors, defines two linear layers with a Tanh activation, trains with BCEWithLogitsLoss + Adam, and evaluates in eval() with gradients disabled.

questions.stem: Feedforward Network (FNN), CNN, RNN, Transformer Architectures Structure, Information Processing, Applicationsలో ఎలా Differ అవుతాయి?
questions.figure:
06 / architecture visual atlas

Four architectures organize connections in different ways

FNN: dense feature mapping. CNN: local spatial filters. RNN: carried state across time. Transformer: attention-based relationships, often trained efficiently in parallel.
options: FNN Time State Track, CNN Attention Score, Transformer Only Sliding Filters Use చేస్తాయని Claim చేస్తుంది. ఇవి Main Architectures Rolesని Confuse చేస్తాయి.
FNN, CNN, RNN, Transformer అన్నింటికీ Same Connections ఉంటాయి; Loss Function మాత్రమే Difference అని Assume చేస్తుంది. Different Structures Important.
CNN Earlier Time Steps Memorize, RNN Image Patches Scan, Transformer Local Convolutions Only Use చేస్తాయని Claim చేస్తుంది. Actual Strengths Different.
FNN Layers ద్వారా Features Transform చేస్తుంది; CNN Spatial Patterns Detect చేస్తుంది; RNN Sequence State Carry చేస్తుంది; Transformer Attentionతో Positions Connect చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Deep Neural Networks Trainingలో Vanishing/Exploding Gradients, Overfitting, Underfitting, Instability, Compute Cost Problemsని Normalization, Residuals, Regularization, Learning Rate Scheduling ఎలా Address చేస్తాయి?
questions.figure:
07 / deep training diagnostics

Diagnose gradients and overfitting—then apply the right fix

Normalization and residual paths help optimization; clipping can limit exploding gradients. Regularization addresses overfitting, while learning-rate scheduling improves convergence. If both training and validation losses stay high, check underfitting; also monitor compute and memory.
options: Gradients Unstable అయినప్పుడల్లా More Hidden Layers, Larger Batches Add చేస్తుంది. Training Loss Jump అవుతున్నా Size Alone Problem Fix చేయలేదు.
Normalization, Residual Connections Gradient Flow Stabilize చేస్తాయి; Regularization Overfitting Reduce చేస్తుంది; Good Learning Rates Too-Large లేదా Too-Small Updates Avoid చేస్తాయి.
Activation Functions, Biases Remove చేస్తే Gradient Problems Automatically Disappear అవుతాయని Assume చేస్తుంది. ఇలా Nonlinear Modeling Power Lose అవుతుంది.
Training Loss Zero చేసే వరకు Validation Check చేయదు; Perfect Training Score New Dataపై Success Guarantee అని Assume చేస్తుంది. ఇది Overfitting Risk.
